## 5. TP-03 overlay (V3 only)

TP-03 publishes entry-window rows and per-parent `OFF_WINDOW_ACTION` / `INITIAL_ENTRY` classes for **body-short** parents only; it publishes **no per-parent window id**. M2-E draws the TP-03 windows as a separate overlay and labels listed parents as TP-03 classes; unlisted parents are labelled `NOT_LISTED_BY_TP03_AS_OFF_WINDOW`, never "in window".

## 6. Reconciliation performed during assembly (all passed)

* Cycle-only lineage (events, episodes, OA, CP) **identical** to the full-ledger lineage restricted to the cycle instruments.
* M2-C: all six committed batch/member/portion files, filtered to the cycle, are **byte-equal** to a per-cycle recomputation with the committed engine.
* M2-D: committed items and all five link views, filtered to the cycle, equal a per-cycle recomputation.
* Independent re-derivation from raw `side × quantity` only (no lineage): signed position per instrument equals the V1 series after every fill; opening + closing quantity = fill quantity for every fill; opened = closed units; final position flat; every fill lies inside 09:14–15:31 IST (rules out UTC read as IST).
